prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY from MaiPace Phố giấy; do not reproduce its whole scene. Match watercolor/gouache pigment, fine expressive dark pencil outlines, softened flat shapes, subtle natural paper grain INSIDE painted shapes, restrained ivory/sand/charcoal/sage palette and occasional muted brick-red. Friendly hand-painted editorial illustration. Not glossy 3D, photorealism, flat vector icon, thick cartoon stroke or anime mascot. No text, letters, numerals, kana/kanji, watermark, logo, labels, UI, borders, circles, panels or multiple images. Produce ONE finished asset. Asset type: reusable vocabulary cutout, square 1:1 canvas, exported at 512x512. TRUE transparent RGBA background outside the object; no opaque paper rectangle, scene, room, people, ground plane, decorative plants, checkerboard drawing or backdrop. Natural paper grain only within colored object surfaces. One single fully visible object centered, occupying approximately 70-75% of the canvas long dimension, generous equal safe margins, crisp readable silhouette at 128px. Soft shading only on the object; no external cast shadow. Subject: ONE traditional wooden graphite pencil placed diagonally across the square, muted ochre/sand hexagonal barrel, clearly sharpened natural wood tip with dark graphite point, plain brick-red painted end cap. Use slightly generous thickness for small-screen visibility, realistic pencil proportions. Whole pencil including point and end visible. No metallic clip, pen nib, button, branding, letters, second pencil, eraser, ruler or extra objects. Light fine charcoal outlines and reference watercolor pigment.
